name: AgentGym
summary: Agent training and evaluation suite exposing diverse interactive environments through a common HTTP interface and Python clients.
description: Public MIT-licensed code with the agentenv client (pip install agentenv). Environment servers expose createEnv, observation, available_actions, step and reset; install each selected agentenv-* environment separately. Covers web, household, games and tool/SQL environments; AgentController connects agents for evaluation, data collection and training. Links AgentEval and AgentTraj-L datasets, whose reuse terms must be checked separately; this entry licenses the code, not every bundled environment or external dataset. Model and environment compute are not included.

agent_access.notes: Public source, agentenv Python client and separately deployed environment servers; no shared hosted endpoint is promised.
